summary: Validated the new 'Homologar plantillas' feature and the global signature variable. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass — (a) POST /api/email-templates/append-signature returns 403 for non-admin (Jrojas) and 401/403 unauthenticated; (b) endpoint is idempotent for admin (rgonzalez) — second call returns updated=0, skipped=48, total=48 with the expected 'Firma agregada a 0 plantilla(s). 48 ya la tenían.' message; (c) preview-email endpoints for /api/clients/{id}, /api/integrators/{id}, /api/new-products/{id} and /api/initial-contacts/{id} all resolve {Firma_Notificacion_Global} (no raw token left in 'message', and 'Mega Soft' razon social present in rendered HTML). Frontend (Playwright on /settings): append-signature-row is visible INSIDE notification-logo-section (Logotipo para Pie de Notificaciones) — confirmed by DOM containment check. The button data-testid='append-signature-button' has the exact text 'Homologar plantillas'. Clicking it (with confirm dialog auto-accepted) triggers POST /api/email-templates/append-signature -> 200 with body {updated:0,skipped:48,total:48} and a success toast 'Firma agregada a 0 plantilla(s). 48 ya la tenían.' is rendered. Variable {Firma_Notificacion_Global} is declared in all 4 frontend picker arrays (ClientEmailDialog VARIABLES, Integrators INTEGRATOR_EMAIL_VARS, NewProducts NP_EMAIL_VARS, InitialContactEmailDialog VARIABLES) — verified via grep on source files.
